name: Opus
text: Naming Terra on day one won this, and dying proved it; but I called Haiku the second killer, and that was my mistake, not his.

On Day 1, Opus claimed to be the officer and said Terra was a killer, but the table voted him out 5 to 2. His card showed officer, so his claim held up. On Night 2 nobody died, and on Day 2 Luna called Sol "my target," which helped the table vote her out as a killer. On Night 3 Sol was killed, and on Day 3 Terra was voted out 3 to 1, then showed her killer card. Every killer is out, so the town wins.
